<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed" xml:id="ex5032023-05-2517-19-32">mngon rtogs kyi don nyid la <rs type="work">'grel pa</rs>r lus rnam bzhag 'chad pa na skabs dang 'brel ba'i dri ba ni shes rab kyi (D3787, 15b7) nas te | mdo'i don spyir ji ltar blta bar bya ba dris pa'o || 
               'di'i lan du <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">rje btsun</rs> gyi lus rnam bzhag nyid 'god pa ni <quote xml:id="d2e551">bshad pa</quote> zhes 'brel ba brtsams nas <quote xml:id="d2e554">shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni </quote>zhes bya ba nas <quote xml:id="d2e557">yang dag brjod ces bya ba yin no</quote>'i bar ro ||(D3787, 16a1–16b2)</seg></TEI>
